about: What is used up: potions, salves, herbs, food and drink, flasks. `use` is what it does, in Kyr's effect language; charges, how many times. Wands and scrolls are wonders (wonders.json).

alchemist_fire.name: Alchemist's Fire
alchemist_fire.description: A sticky, flammable substance that ignites when exposed to air.

ale.name: Ale
ale.description: A mug of frothy ale to quench your thirst after a long day of adventuring.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.description: A single dose removes the poisoned condition from a living companion.

source.notes: Orsino removes the status named Poison; Kyr removes poisoned.

bandages.name: Bandages
bandages.description: Clean linen for binding wounds. One use.

source.notes: Starting gear of the medic; absent from Orsino's gear catalog.

cloudberry.name: Cloudberry
cloudberry.description: A rare berry that grows in cold, mountainous regions. It has a sweet and tangy flavor and is said to have mild healing properties.

comfrey.name: Comfrey
comfrey.description: A leafy herb known for its ability to promote rapid healing of wounds and broken bones.
comfrey.use: Heal (2d4) health to ally. Remove bleed from ally.

dandelion.name: Dandelion
dandelion.description: A common herb known for its detoxifying properties. It can be used to create a tea that helps cleanse the body of toxins.
dandelion.use: Heal (1d3) health to ally. Remove poison from ally.

elixir_of_strength.name: Elixir of Strength
elixir_of_strength.description: A potent brew that temporarily enhances the drinker's physical strength.
elixir_of_strength.use: Apply strength to ally for 3 turns.

feverwort.name: Feverwort
feverwort.description: Dried feverwort, wrapped in a cloth by a herb-wife. Steeped, it breaks a child's fever; laid on a wound, it eases it a little. One use.

source.notes: What the herb-wife sends with one who comes for a sick child (the herbs origin).

oil_firebomb.name: Oil firebomb
oil_firebomb.description: A stoppered flask of lamp oil with a rag in its neck. Lit and thrown, it bursts in fire over what it strikes, if it is not dodged: a soldier's or a carter's makeshift, cheap where lamp oil is sold, for a thing steel barely harms: not an alchemist's fire, which clings and cannot be dodged.
oil_firebomb.use: Deal (1d6) fire damage to enemy unless dexterity save against (11).

source.notes: The answer to a foe that shrugs off weapons, sold where lamp oil is (PT-23).

fireproof_salve.name: Fireproof salve
fireproof_salve.description: A clay pot of ash-and-lanolin salve. Smeared on skin and clothing, it makes fire do half its harm for a while.
fireproof_salve.use: Apply fireproof to ally for 10 turns.

source.notes: A Kyr preparation of Orsino's fireproof; lasts ten of the wearer's combat turns.

first_aid_kit.name: First Aid Kit
first_aid_kit.description: A small kit containing bandages and salves for treating minor wounds.
first_aid_kit.use: Heal (1d4+1) health to ally. Remove bleed from ally.

goodberry_consumable.name: Goodberry
goodberry_consumable.description: A small, red berry that provides nourishment and minor healing when consumed.

healing_potion.name: Potion of Healing
healing_potion.description: A vial of shimmering red liquid that restores a moderate amount of health when consumed.

heather.name: Heather
heather.description: A fragrant herb that can be brewed into a tea to soothe aches and pains.
heather.use: Heal (1d3+1) health to ally. Remove fatigue from ally.

herb_poultice.name: Herb poultice
herb_poultice.description: A pad of bruised leaves bound in a strip of linen, laid on a hurt and tied: it draws the heat out and closes it a little.

source.notes: Made of any herb good for healing and bandages (HerbRecipes).

herbs.name: Healing herbs
herbs.description: A twist of dried herbs for a poultice. One use.

source.notes: Starting gear of the medic; absent from Orsino's gear catalog.

holy_water.name: Holy water
holy_water.description: A small glass vial of water blessed at a shrine. Thrown on the dead that walk, it burns them as fire would.

source.notes: Orsino's harms the undead and Kyr could not use it; here it is thrown for radiant harm, at a sexton's price, the answer to the walking dead for a company with no cleric (PT-23).

kingsfoil.name: Kingsfoil
kingsfoil.description: A three-leaf herb known also as Aelvenroot, prized for its potent healing properties when brewed into a tea or poultice.
kingsfoil.use: Heal (2d4+2) health to ally. Remove poison from ally.

major_healing_potion.name: Major Potion of Healing
major_healing_potion.description: A vial of glowing red liquid that restores a significant amount of health when consumed.

minor_healing_potion.name: Minor Potion of Healing
minor_healing_potion.description: A vial of glittering red liquid that restores health when consumed.

potion_of_barkskin.name: Potion of Barkskin
potion_of_barkskin.description: A vial of thick, green liquid that hardens the drinker's skin, providing additional protection.

rashers.name: Rashers of Bacon
rashers.description: Cured strips of pork that can be cooked and eaten for sustenance.

vinegar.name: Vinegar
vinegar.description: A bottle of vinegar for cooking or cleaning wounds.

willow_bark.name: Willow bark
willow_bark.description: Strips of bark from a riverbank willow. Steeped, it breaks a fever; chewed, it eases a hurt a little. One use.

source.notes: What a willow gives whoever gathers it (organisms.json); the fever on the green wants it, or herbs.

wine.name: Wine
wine.description: A bottle of fine wine to celebrate a successful adventure.

yarrow_poultice.name: Prepared yarrow poultice
yarrow_poultice.description: Crushed yarrow bound in a cloth. It stops bleeding and eases a small wound.
yarrow_poultice.use: Remove bleeding from ally. Heal (1d3) health to ally.

foxglove.name: Foxglove
foxglove.description: A beautiful but poisonous flower. When prepared correctly, it can be used to create a potent healing salve.
foxglove.use: Heal (1d4+2) health to ally. Remove poison from ally. Remove fatigue from ally. Remove weakened from ally.

oil_flask.name: Flask of Oil
oil_flask.description: A flask of slippery oil that can be thrown onto a surface or creature to make it more vulnerable to fire.
oil_flask.use: Apply oiled to enemy for 3 turns unless reflex save against (25).
